items.description:
a2 Milk® Full Cream 3L is fresh Australian milk from specially selected cows that naturally produce milk containing only A2-type beta‑casein protein and no A1 protein. This creamy and delicious milk delivers a source of protein and is also high in calcium.

With less than 4g of fat per 100mL, a2 Milk® Full Cream has a rich and creamy taste which is perfect for everyday enjoyment in coffee, cereal, smoothies or cooking.

Unlike ordinary milk, a2 Milk® comes from cows specially selected to naturally produce milk with only A2-type beta-casein protein and no A1 protein, which may be easier on digestion for some people. a2 Milk® is backed by 20 years of scientific research into milk proteins, and more consumers are choosing it as part of their everyday routine without compromising on taste.

Find out more about the a2 Milk® difference at www.a2milk.com.au

a2 Milk® comes from cows specially selected to naturally produce milk with only A2-type beta-casein protein and no A1 protein, so it may be easier on digestion than ordinary milk for some milk-intolerant individuals when consumed as part of a healthy, varied diet.

Allergen may be present: Milk

Country of Origin: Australia
items.name: A2 Milk Full Cream Milk

Pauls Zymil Milk is lactose free milk that is easy to digest

As part of a varied and healthy diet, consuming Zymil instead of regular milk helps ease digestion in those who are sensitive to lactose.
